description: This Java class defines the HttpOverrideForwardedRequest, a specialized request object for overriding HTTP requests and responses in a mock server environment. It includes static builder methods for creating instances with various override configurations, getter and setter methods for request and response modifications, and overrides for equality and hash code calculations.
